name: cc.axiv/pay
title: Axiv Pay
description: Stablecoin payments straight to your wallet. Free catalog search; payment tools use your API key.

tools.name: search_capabilities
tools.description: Search the public Axiv Pay integration catalog by chain, asset, role, category, status, or text. Catalog statuses describe integration coverage. paymentSurfaces in the result says which ways to take a payment work right now (payment API checkout, test checkout, hosted payment links), read live from the payment API capabilities. Never authorizes or submits a payment.

tools.name: get_capability
tools.description: Get a public capability with payment flow, request and response examples, limitations, and quickstart.

tools.name: compare_capabilities
tools.description: Compare two to four public capability IDs returned by search_capabilities.

tools.name: get_payment_status
tools.description: Read the status, order reference, payment terms, receipt evidence and settlement model of one payment from the live payment API. EXTERNAL payments finish at PAID; settlementStatus NOT_TRACKED means the execution channel manages solver reimbursement outside Axiv Pay. Do not wait for SETTLED on that model. Compare merchantReference, destination recipient/token/chain and minimum amount with your order before fulfilling. This does not independently verify chain finality. Requires your own Axiv Pay API token in the Authorization: Bearer header of the MCP HTTP request, never as a tool argument. Returns only payments that token can read. Read-only. Never authorizes, submits, or changes a payment.

tools.name: check_payment_route
tools.description: Answer "can a customer pay with this stablecoin on this chain while I receive that stablecoin on that chain?" from the live payment API. Returns check.quotable (an executable quote is available right now), and when quotable: youPay, sellerReceivesAtLeast, routeCostBps, axivFeeBps 0, payerNetworkFeeUsd, estimatedDurationMs, and verifiedLive (the route has already paid out with a real transfer). When not quotable, check.reason is NO_ROUTE or SAME_ASSET. amount is what the seller receives, as a decimal string; default 10. No token needed. Creates, reserves, and signs nothing. Call once per combination the user chose, not per keystroke: checks are rate limited per caller.

sourceChainId.description: Chain the customer pays on, as a decimal chain ID such as "8453".

sourceAsset.description: Stablecoin the customer pays with, such as "USDT".

destinationChainId.description: Chain the seller receives on, such as "42161".

destinationAsset.description: Stablecoin the seller receives, such as "USDC".

amount.description: Optional. Amount the seller receives, such as "25.00". Default 10.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Step 1 of a payment. Ask the live payment API for a quote to pay a recipient on a destination chain from a source chain. Returns the route, fee estimate, expected and minimum receive amounts, and expiresAt. A quote is not a payment and moves no funds. Send exactly one of sourceAsset or sourceTokenAddress, and exactly one of destinationAsset or destinationTokenAddress. The returned quote is checked against every term you sent: chains, amount, recipient, assets or tokens, payer, and allowed routes. Next: create_payment. Requires your own Axiv Pay API token in the Authorization: Bearer header of the MCP HTTP request, never as a tool argument. This tool does not sign or send any blockchain transaction. Axiv Pay holds no keys. Your own wallet signs the step returned by get_funding_step.

sourceChainId.description: Source EVM chain ID as a decimal string, for example "8453".

sourceAsset.description: Source asset symbol, for example "USDC". Omit when sourceTokenAddress is set.

sourceTokenAddress.description: Source token contract. Omit when sourceAsset is set. 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Not the zero address.

amountAtomic.description: Amount the payer sends, in atomic units of the source asset, as a positive integer string with no decimal point. 10 USDC with 6 decimals is "10000000".

destinationChainId.description: Destination EVM chain ID as a decimal string, for example "42161".

destinationAsset.description: Destination asset symbol. Omit when destinationTokenAddress is set.

destinationTokenAddress.description: Destination token contract. Omit when destinationAsset is set. 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Not the zero address.

recipient.description: Account that receives the payout on the destination chain. 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Not the zero address.

payer.description: Optional. Account that will fund the payment on the source chain. If omitted here, create_payment needs it. 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Not the zero address.

allowedRoutes.description: Optional. Restrict the quote to these route names, for example ["ACROSS"].

tools.name: create_payment
tools.description: Step 2 of a payment. Create one payment from a quote before the quote expires. Creating a payment moves no funds and signs nothing. idempotencyKey is required: choose a new unique key for each new payment and keep it. Calling again with the same key and the same arguments returns the same payment instead of creating another one. If the response is lost, unreadable, or the call fails with retrySameRequest true, call again with the SAME arguments and the SAME key. That is the only way to read the payment back when you have no payment ID. Never switch to a new key for the same purchase. The result reports whether the payment was CREATED or REPLAYED, and nextAction. Next: get_funding_step when nextAction is REQUEST_FUNDING_INSTRUCTIONS. Requires your own Axiv Pay API token in the Authorization: Bearer header of the MCP HTTP request, never as a tool argument. This tool does not sign or send any blockchain transaction. Axiv Pay holds no keys. Your own wallet signs the step returned by get_funding_step.

quoteId.description: quoteId returned by create_quote ("quote_" followed by a UUID).

idempotencyKey.description: Your unique key for this payment, 8 to 128 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -. Reuse the same key when retrying.

merchantReference.description: Optional order or invoice reference, up to 100 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -.

payer.description: Account that will fund the payment. Required if the quote was created without a payer. 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Not the zero address.

tools.name: get_funding_step
tools.description: Step 3 of a payment. Return the one transaction the payer wallet must send now, on the payment source chain, so it can send exactly that transaction. An APPROVAL step moves no funds. A BRIDGE_DEPOSIT step moves the payment amount. Send it only from the payer account, then call submit_funding_transaction. Only wallet transactions are offered. A payment that asks for an EIP-712 signature step returns an error and must not be signed. If the wallet result is unknown, do NOT sign again: look up the transaction hash and submit it. A "nothing to sign" result (outcome WAIT) is a normal wait, not a failure. A result marked simulated must not be signed with real funds. Repeat this tool while nextAction is REQUEST_FUNDING_INSTRUCTIONS. Requires your own Axiv Pay API token in the Authorization: Bearer header of the MCP HTTP request, never as a tool argument. This tool does not sign or send any blockchain transaction. Axiv Pay holds no keys. Your own wallet signs the step returned by get_funding_step.

paymentId.description: Axiv Pay payment ID returned by create_payment.

tools.name: submit_funding_transaction
tools.description: Step 4 of a payment. After your wallet sent the transaction from get_funding_step, register its transaction hash with the payment. This tool accepts a transaction hash only. It does not accept signatures. Registering a hash authorizes nothing and moves nothing, and it is not a deposit confirmation: the payment status changes only after the chain confirms it. Submitting the same hash again is safe. Next: get_funding_step while nextAction is REQUEST_FUNDING_INSTRUCTIONS, then get_payment_status until PAID. Requires your own Axiv Pay API token in the Authorization: Bearer header of the MCP HTTP request, never as a tool argument. This tool does not sign or send any blockchain transaction. Axiv Pay holds no keys. Your own wallet signs the step returned by get_funding_step.

paymentId.description: Axiv Pay payment ID returned by create_payment.

txHash.description: Hash of the transaction your wallet sent for this step. 0x followed by 64 hex characters.

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Create a payment link that a customer pays from their own wallet, with no site or backend on your side. amount is what the recipient receives, as a decimal string such as "25.00". The customer picks a stablecoin they hold and pays the route cost on top. Returns url to share. A single-use link closes after one payment; set reusable to accept more. Creating a link moves no funds. Calling again creates another link. Available only while GET https://api.pay.axiv.cc/v1/capabilities reports paymentLinks true. Check that first. While it is false the payment API answers PAYMENT_LINKS_UNAVAILABLE and nothing is created. Requires your own Axiv Pay API token in the Authorization: Bearer header of the MCP HTTP request, never as a tool argument.

destinationChainId.description: Chain the recipient receives on, as a decimal string, for example "42161".

destinationAsset.description: Asset the recipient receives, for example "USDC".

amount.description: Amount the recipient receives, as a decimal string such as "25.00". No atomic units.

recipient.description: Optional. Wallet that receives the payment. Defaults to the wallet of the account that owns the token. 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Not the zero address.

title.description: Optional. What the payment is for, shown to the customer. Up to 80 characters.

merchantReference.description: Optional order or invoice reference, up to 100 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -.

reusable.description: Optional. true accepts more than one payment with this link. Default false.

tools.name: get_payment_link
tools.description: Read one of your payment links: its status, amount, url, and its most recent payments. Fulfill an order only when its payment is PAID. Available only while GET https://api.pay.axiv.cc/v1/capabilities reports paymentLinks true. Check that first. While it is false the payment API answers PAYMENT_LINKS_UNAVAILABLE and nothing is created. Requires your own Axiv Pay API token in the Authorization: Bearer header of the MCP HTTP request, never as a tool argument.

linkId.description: Payment link ID returned by create_payment_link ("plink_…").

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Read this month's completed payment volume, the free allowance left, Axiv fees charged, and your request limits. Takes no arguments. Requires your own Axiv Pay API token in the Authorization: Bearer header of the MCP HTTP request, never as a tool argument.
